book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Mak beleŋ Mere igiŋ Yesu niŋ yitiŋ kayyiŋ

content: Yesu beleŋ al uŋguram yaŋ sope iryiŋ
Be, Yesuya komatmiŋya gobe Galili fe ala kuruŋ siŋa kurhan Gerasa marte naŋare forok yamiŋ.
Irdeb Yesu gobe hakwa tubul teŋ siŋare kat kukeb al kura uŋguram yaŋ beleŋ Yesu kene yeŋ bembare mat wayyiŋ.
Al gobe bembayaŋ ferde kuŋ hiyen. Yeŋbe al beleŋ epte ma tanarde fere titek. Kaŋ tareŋ sende wor epte ma fere titek hiyen.
Tanarde kahaŋya haniŋya fere teŋ haŋyen. Gega sen kiriŋtiktuk heŋ kahaŋde niŋ ain manaŋ yukala teŋ hiyen. Niŋgeb al beleŋ epte ma hikaka irde fere titek hiyen.
Yeŋbe hugiŋeŋ duguyaŋ kuŋ bembayaŋ heŋ kekew teŋ sikkeŋ hora po ilka teŋ hiyen.
Be, al gore Yesu go gisaw mat po keneŋbe kup yeŋ waŋ Yesu kahaŋ miŋde kateŋ dokolhoŋ yuguluŋ tiyyiŋ.

Irkeb Yesu beleŋ uŋgura goyen, “Uŋgura, gebe nurde guneŋ hime. Al ga tubul teŋ kat kwa!” inkeb uŋgura gobe woywoy yeŋ kekew teŋbe, “Yesu! Gebe Al Kuruŋ tareŋmiŋ kuruŋ wor po gote Urmiŋ. Daha nireŋ teŋ ha? ‘Buluŋ ma gireŋ,’ nineŋbe masi tiyayiŋ,” yeŋ eseŋ mere iryiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ, “Deŋgebe ganuŋ?” inyiŋ. Irkeb wol heŋbe, “Neŋbe budam po hite geb, deŋnebe Legiyon,”
inyiŋ.
Irdeb, “Naŋa hitere gar mat hoyaŋde ma dakira tiyayiŋ,” ineŋ eseŋ mere irde parsay iryiŋ.
Be, mel go hinhan bindere gorbe bu budam wor po dugu dabayiŋde kura gor nuku teŋ dulaŋ teŋ hinhan.
Irkeb uŋgura buda goreb, “Ge beleŋ ok dinkeb kuŋ bu iro ketal yurniŋ,” ineŋ Yesu eseŋ mere iramiŋ.

Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Igiŋ,” yinkeb uŋgura buda goyen al go tubul teŋ kuŋ bu buda goyen ketal yuramiŋ. Irkeb bu buda 2,000 goyen tumŋaŋ hul yeŋ kuŋ hamulare mat fe ala bana kurkuŋ fe nene kamamiŋ.
Irkeb bu doyaŋ mar beleŋ mata goyen keneŋbe busaharde tiyuŋmiŋyaŋ irde meteŋyaŋ kuŋbe mata forok yiriŋ goke tagalde tukamiŋ. Irkeb mere go nurdeb al budam mata goyen kinniŋ yeŋ kwamiŋ.
Kuŋbe uŋgura ketal urtiŋ al go dufaymiŋ wuk yitiŋde umŋa teŋbe Yesu hinhinde gor keperde hike keneŋbe kafura hamiŋ.
Irkeb mata go forok yeke kenamiŋ mar goreb uŋgura ketal urtiŋ al goyen daha mat igiŋ hiriŋ goyabe bu fe nene kamamiŋya goyen goke momoŋ yiramiŋ.
Irkeb al buda gore mere go nurde kafura heŋbe Yesu goyen, “Naŋa ga tubul teŋ kwayiŋ,” inamiŋ.
Gwaha inkeb hakwa hende hurkuŋ hikeb sope iryiŋ al goreb, “Yesu, igiŋ gama gireŋ?” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ ok ma ineŋbe, “Mulgaŋ heŋ tayge hitte kuŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ buniŋeŋ girde sope gira goke momoŋ yirayiŋ,” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Dekapolis naŋa bana Yesu beleŋ sope iryiŋ goyen tagalde tukuŋ hinhin. Tukukeb al budam al go keneŋ meremiŋ nurdeb diliŋ fot yamiŋ.
Yesu beleŋ garbam bereya bere dirŋeŋ kamtiŋ sope yiryiŋ
Be, Yesu gob sopte mulgaŋ heŋ fe ala kuruŋ siŋa kurhan Kapeneam kuŋ fe siŋare hikeb al budam waŋ gabu irde kalyaŋ keramiŋ.
Irkeb gor niŋ Yuda marte gabu ya doyaŋ al kura Yairus gore Yesu hitte wayyiŋ. Waŋ keneŋ yende palap matare Yesu kahaŋ miŋde urguŋ kaŋ kuku teŋbe,
“Werne kameŋ teŋ hi. Niŋgeb araŋ waŋ hange kerd unkeb igiŋ heŋ huwaryeŋ,” ineŋ eseŋ mere iryiŋ.
Irkeb meremiŋ goyen nurde Yesu go yeŋya kwaryum. Kuŋ hikeyab al budam kalyaŋ kerde tawtaw irde gama irde hinhan.
Be, goya goyenbe bere kura danduku miŋyaŋ goyen al gabu irde kuŋ hinhan bana goŋ kuŋ hinhin. Garbam gobe gayakkek moŋ. Damamiŋbe 12.

Niŋgeb bere gobe garbam goke guram al budam hitte sope nirnaŋ yeŋ kuŋ heŋbe horamiŋ go hende pasi irde hiyen. Goyenpoga guram kurayen kurayen gore igiŋ ma irde hiyen. Igiŋ hitŋeŋbe buluŋ wor po heŋ hiyen.
Gega Yesuyen mere momoŋ nurde hiyen geb, “Kuŋ amilmiŋ po sisaŋ urdeb igiŋ heweŋ,” yeŋ dufaymiŋ saŋiŋ irdeb kuŋ al buda goyen pota yirde Yesu harhok beleŋ mat amilmiŋ sisaŋ uryiŋ.
Irkeb dari temeyde hiyen goyen goyare po hubu hiriŋ. Irkeb, “Garbam go nubul tiya,” yeŋ nuryiŋ.
Be, goya goyen po Yesube tareŋmiŋ tubul teŋ kuriŋ goyen nuryiŋ. Nurdeb al budam gama irde hinhan goyen fulgaŋ kaŋbe, “Ganuŋ beleŋ sisaŋ nura?” yineŋ gusuŋaŋ yiryiŋ.
Irkeb komatmiŋ yago beleŋ, “Al karim ma kalyaŋ gerde haŋ gayen go ma yeneŋbe ‘Ganuŋ sisaŋ nura?’ yeŋ gusuŋaŋ heŋ ha?” inamiŋ.
Gega Yesube, “Ganuŋ beleŋ sisaŋ nura?” yeŋ naŋkeneŋ po hinhin.

Irkeb bere gobe uliŋde mata forok yiriŋ goyen nurdeb kafura heŋ barbar yeŋbe waŋ Yesu kahaŋ miŋde kateŋ dokolhoŋ yuguluŋ teŋbe, “Ne beleŋ tihim,” ineŋ garbam bikkeŋ hiyen goyen goke fudinde po momoŋ iryiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ, “Werne, Al Kuruŋ beleŋ dufayge tareŋ go keneŋbe sope gira geb, kandukge hubu hihi. Niŋgeb amaŋeŋ nurde kwayiŋ,” inyiŋ.
Be, Yesu beleŋ bere goyen mere irde hikeyabe al kura gabu ya gote doyaŋ al Yairusyen yare mat waŋbe, “Werge bikkeŋ kama geb, tisa ga tuktawaŋ irde ma,” inamiŋ.
Gwaha inkeb Yesu mere go nurdeb Yairus inyiŋ. “Kafura heŋ ma yo. Al Kuruŋ niŋ po dufayge saŋiŋ irayiŋ.”
Gwaha ineŋbe yeŋ gama irde hinhan mar gob tumŋaŋ yakira teŋbe Pita, Yemsya kuliŋ Yonya po yade kuriŋ.
Be, kuŋ Yairusyen yare forok yeŋbe gor hinhan mar gore eseŋ naŋa teŋ kekew teŋ epte ma teŋ hinhan goyen yinyiŋ.
Irdeb ya bana hurkuŋbe, “Daniŋ kekew teŋ eseŋ buluŋ po teŋ haŋ? Diriŋ gabe ma kama. Duliŋ ferde hi,” yinyiŋ.

Gwaha yinkeb gor hinhan mar gore hinmaŋ iramiŋ. Irkeb Yesu beleŋ ya bana hinhan mar go, “Siŋare kunaŋ!” yineŋ yakira teŋbe diriŋ gote miliŋya naniŋya irde komatmiŋ karwo go po yade diriŋ hakwam hinhin bana goŋ hurkamiŋ.
Irdeb diriŋ gote haniŋ tanarde, “Talita, kum!” inyiŋ. (Meremiŋ gote miŋbe, “Bere dirŋeŋ, ne beleŋ ginhem ge. Huwara!”)
Irkeb goyare po bere dirŋeŋ go huwarde goyaŋ go kuŋ waŋ tiyyiŋ. (Yeŋbe damamiŋ 12.) Gwaha tikeb go kenamiŋ marbe diliŋ fot yamiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ, “Mata kenhaŋ gayen gake ma wor wor tagalde tukunayiŋ,” yineŋbe, “Bere dirŋeŋ ga biŋge kura unke niwi,” yinyiŋ.

footnotes.text: Legiyon gote miŋbe fuleŋa mar budam 5,000 niŋ yitiŋ.
